method.strictAssertions: Normal/crash x preparation/playing/paused/buffering; actual OS worker exit, filesClosed receipts, original SHA and append after death, same-profile recovery/new explicit Play, no cross-player effects
method.nativeGuard: Held output reader: controller destruction remains asynchronous, settleExit(50 ms) false and cache retained; actual reader close followed by settleExit(1500 ms) true and cache removed
method.qtFullSuites: 12 separate CTest groups each Linux GCC / Windows MinGW; SDK unit plus actual decoder/API/playback and real writer heartbeat deadlines
method.staleArtifacts: Only result.json from completed exit-0 runs with matching player/test hashes is evidence; pre-existing error.txt in reused build-report folders is not counted as a new failure

openItems: Original Linux manual-pause heartbeat release >2 s outlier remains unexplained; final process-exit wait changes a different path. This repeat heartbeat suite passed but does not close the original outlier.
Forced worker crash, mid-I/O races, surviving external readers and extended continuous stress matrix.
Other codec/container profiles, arbitrary filesystem/driver hangs, and full integration/numerical technical-spec acceptance.
Real Harvester integration remains forbidden in this player-only task; no completed full technical-spec claim.
